description: 臺北翡翠水庫淤積調查報告 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北翡翠水庫管理局. 翡翠水庫淤積調查從78年開始執行，為每年例行作業，透過斷面測量再據以統計分析水庫年淤積量，以作為水庫操作運轉、集水區管理及日後辦理清淤計畫之依據。 本年度(112年)水庫淤積量23. 4萬立方公尺，換算年淤積速率約為水庫初期總容量千分之0. 58。 自73年6月水庫初期蓄水至112年底止總淤積量約為2,805. 5萬立方公尺，約佔水庫初期... Coverage: Feitsui Reservoir. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北翡翠水庫管理局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
